convention_validation.interpretation: All three orientation/sign discriminators are unanimous. The per-radian candidate wins the per-shot absolute-closeness comparison on 96 of 100 shots; the four nonpassing frames are retained rather than excluded. The corpus medians differ by 2*pi to floating-point precision and the per-radian median remains close to the recorded-current scale, supporting the integrated authority without claiming unanimity.
